query_english: Why is it important to drink clean water?
response_english:
Drinking clean water is vital for our bodies.

It helps keep our organs working correctly.
Clean water removes harmful germs and dirt.
This helps prevent diseases like diarrhea and typhoid.

Drinking clean water also keeps our skin and hair healthy.
It helps us focus and feel energetic throughout the day.

This is general information. Please consult a doctor or health worker. [ANSWER SOURCE: GROQ]
